# Step - replace

`replace` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Replaces every occurrence of a substring in each string.

## Forms

```text
replace(arg1: any, arg2: any)
replace(arg1: Scope, arg2: any, arg3: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").replace("ar", "AR").next()   // mARko
```
